content: Tsauru kemɨtiuhayewaxɨ
Hikɨ Tsauru 'uxiwa'atɨ 'akuxi mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ mɨwakwinikekai Ti'aitame teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama, kaninuani mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa,

kanitawawirieni xapate mɨtiwati'utɨirienikɨ tukita miemete Ramatsikutsie, mɨpaɨ 'utaineme: «Xɨkatsɨ 'ikɨ waretaxeiya hipame mɨkɨ huyeta miemete 'ukitsi 'ukari, kaniwarahapamɨkɨ mehɨatɨkaime Kerutsareme paitɨ».
Hikɨ huyeta 'uyemiekaku, Ramatsiku 'aye'aximekaku, 'auriena kaniukumerɨka taheima miemekɨ.
Kwiepa 'ukaweka kani'enieni xeime mɨpaɨ haineme: —Tsauru 'aku, Tsauru, ¿titayari penetikuweiyane 'ekɨ?

Mɨkɨ rehɨawe: —¿'Ekɨ Ti'aitame kemɨ'ane pepetaine? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Netsɨ Ketsutsi nekanihɨkɨtɨni pemɨnetsikuweiyane. Pɨmatsi'ukukuine pemɨka'awaɨriyakɨ, pemɨti'aketsinakɨ pe'anatseiwatɨ titsewemekɨ.

Tsauru 'uyɨyɨakatɨ matɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ti'aitame, tita matinake yanemɨtiyurieni. Ti'aitame rehɨawe: —Hikɨ kenanukukexi, kiekaritsie keneutahaki. Manari yapepɨretahɨawarieni kemɨreuyewetse yapemɨtiyurienenikɨ.
Teɨteri hamatɨana memuhukai mehɨxiyatɨ 'ameniti'uni me'i'enietɨ kemɨ'ane mutaniu, peru meka'ixeiyatɨ.
Hikɨ Tsauru kwiepa kananukukeni, yuhɨxita 'anutaniereka tixaɨ pɨkatiuxei, mamayatsie metiwɨtɨ mepeiha, Ramatsiku paitɨ mekani'atɨani.
Haika tukari puyuri kaheunieretɨ katikwatɨ kaharetɨ.

Hikɨ xewitɨ mana kaniuyeikakaitɨni Ramatsikutsie tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame 'Ananiyaxi titewatɨ, tɨkarikɨ heinɨtsita Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Ananiyaxi. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ti'aitame, ne nekanihɨkɨtɨni.
Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ rehɨawe: —Kenanukukexi, kenemie kaye Mɨxeuraɨye mɨtitewa 'utɨa, Kura kiita keneta'iwau tarutsutanaka Tsauru mɨtitewa. Mana peyunenewie.
Mɨkɨta heinɨtsita kanixeiya tewi 'Ananiyaxi titewakame mana ye'arɨkame heimana 'utimekame manutanierekɨ.
'Ananiyaxi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ti'aitame, nepɨwaru'eni yumɨireme metekuxatame 'ikɨ tewi hepaɨtsita, naime 'axakemɨwayurienekai mɨkɨ 'ateɨterima Kerutsaremetsie.
'Enata heitserie mekanipitɨani mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame mɨwaranutaxɨrɨwanikɨ yunaime memɨmatsi'ayexeiya.
Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kenemietsɨ. Ne 'ikɨ nepenayexei, mɨtihekɨatanikɨ nehepaɨtsita nuiwarite wahɨxie, kwiepa te'aitamete meta 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie.
Nekatinita'ɨkitɨamɨkɨ kemɨreuyewetse mɨtikwinekɨ nehetsiemieme.

Hikɨ 'Ananiyaxi kaneyani, kiita kaneutahani. Heimana 'utimeka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Ne'iwa Tsauru, Ti'aitame ne kaneneyenɨ'ani, mɨkɨ Ketsutsi pemuxei huyeta pe'aye'aximetɨ, mɨkɨ kaneneyenɨ'ani peheunieretɨ pemayanikɨ, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ pemɨhɨnenikɨ».
Yapauka panayexɨri hɨxitana kunieri hepaɨ 'anenetɨ, heunieretɨ kanayani. 'Anukukeka kaniuka'ɨyarieni,
tiukwakari tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kanayani. Hikɨ Ramatsikutsie puyeikakai yapaɨmexɨa tukari teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahamatɨa.
Tsauru Ramatsikutsie meta Kerutsaremetsie kemɨtikuxatakai
Kwitɨwa huriyutsixi watukiteta katinihekɨatakaitɨni Ketsutsi hepaɨtsita: «'Iya Kakaɨyari kaninu'ayatɨni» 'utaitɨ.

Mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni yunaitɨ memi'eniekai, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni kemɨ'ane mɨwaraye'uniekai mɨkɨ memehɨawe mɨkɨ kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨ Kerutsareme kiekatari, 'uwata 'ayumieme kaninuani, mɨwaranuwitɨnikɨ mehɨatɨkaime mawari wewiwamete memɨhɨritɨarie wahetsɨa».
Tsauru yemekɨ kanitɨrɨkariyarieximekaitɨni. Kaniwa'iyarixitɨakaitɨni huriyutsixi Ramatsikutsie memɨtamakai, kaniwarutahekɨatɨani kename Ketsusi Metsiyaxi
hɨkɨ.
Hikɨ mɨixa tukari 'utixɨku huriyutsixi mekaniyu'enieni me'imienike.
Tsauru katinetimani kememɨteyurienikekai. Kiekari kitenitetsie tukarikɨ meta tɨkarikɨ mekanihupiekaitɨni me'imienike.
Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yɨwikɨta kiriwatsie me'ikayeka tetsariya warie mekaneikatuani.
Hikɨ Kerutsareme nuaka pɨtiwiyamɨkɨkai teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahetsie. Yunaitɨ mepimakarɨkai yuri mekate'erietɨ kename tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwametɨkai.

Werunawe heiwitɨka kani'atɨani nɨ'ariekate wahetsɨa. Kaniwarutahekɨatɨani ya'utaitɨ kename huyeta Ti'aitame 'uxei, meta 'itahɨawixɨ, kename Ramatsikutsie kamatɨ tikuxatakai Ketsutsi hetsɨa miemetɨtɨ kemɨtixɨnakai.
Hikɨ wahetsɨa kaniuyuhayewa Kerutsaremetsie naitsarie kuyeikatɨ, hekɨakamekɨ tikuxatatɨ Ti'aitame hetsiemieme.
Pɨkamakai mɨtaniunikɨ Ti'aitame hetsɨa mɨmiemetɨkaikɨ. Niuki kanixɨatɨakaitɨni kɨriyekutsixi waniukikɨ memutiniukakai wahamatɨa. Mɨmetsɨ mekanimiekukaitɨni.
'Iwamama yametehetimaika mekaneiwitɨni Tsetsareyatsie paitɨ, Tarutsu paitɨ mekaneitanɨ'ani.

Hikɨ memɨyutixexeɨriwakai naitsarie Kureyatsie, Karereyatsie, Tsamariyatsie mepɨka'uximatɨariekai. Mepɨtɨrɨkariyariekai, Ti'aitame me'ayemakatɨ 'amekaniu'uwakaitɨni, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata mɨiremekɨ kaniwatuikakaitɨni.
'Eneyaxi 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ kemɨratɨa meta Rurukaxi
Hikɨ Pekuru naitsarie pukuyeikakai, manata penua Kakaɨyari teɨterimama wahetsɨa Riratsie memɨtamakai.
Mana kanikaxeiya xeime tewi 'Eneyaxi mɨtitewakai 'atahaika wiyari mɨyuriekai yu'utatsie kakaitɨ mɨhuriekaikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ Pekuru katinitahɨawe: «'Eneyaxi 'aku, Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu 'aixɨa pɨmatsi'uyuri. Kenanukukexi, 'a'itsi keneutatuna». Yapauka kananukukeni.
Yunaitɨ Riratsie Tsarunitsie memɨtamakai mekanixeiyakaitɨni, mɨkɨta mete'uhayewaka ke'axamemɨteyuriekai Ti'aitametsie mekateniuwiya.
Hikɨ tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame 'uka Kupetsie nekateitɨni Tawita titewatɨ (taniukikɨ Rurukaxi titewatɨ, Maxama titewatɨ). Mɨkɨ 'aixɨa ti'aneneme katiniyurienekaitɨni kwini mieme, katiniyukanenimayakaitɨni.
Hikɨ 'ana tiutakwineka kaniumɨni. Me'itahauxika kii taɨta mekaneitateni.

Hikɨ Riratsie pehurakai Kupe, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete me'u'enanaka kename Pekuru mana heyeikakai, hetsɨana mekaniwarenɨ'ani 'ukitsi yuhutame mɨpaɨ mete'itawawirienike: «Penɨkahɨrixɨa 'areutewini tahetsɨa pemɨnuanikɨ».

Pekuru 'anukukeka wahamatɨa petɨa, nuaku kii taɨta mekaneitiwitɨni. 'Auriena mekaniu'axɨani yunaitɨ 'ukari wakɨnama memukwi, me'utitsuatɨ me'ixeitsitɨatɨ 'ixurikite tetɨata miemete herie miemete miwewiekai Maxama wahetsɨa 'uyeikatɨ.

Yunaime Pekuru kaniwaranuyenɨ'ani, 'utitunumakeka kaniyutanenewieni. Ta'aurie 'aweka kaxari manukatei mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Tawita 'aku, kenanukukexi». Mɨkɨ kananutaniere. Pekuru 'uxeiyaka 'aniutayerɨni.
'Iya mamayatsie tiwiereka kanenukuhana. Yuhetsɨa kaniwarutahɨawe Kakaɨyari teɨterimama 'ukari meta wakɨnama memukwi wahamatɨa, kaniyetuani 'ayeniereme.
Naitsarie Kupetsie kaniutamariwa, yuwaɨkawatɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni Ti'aitame hetsie.
Mɨixa tukari Kupetsie pekatei Tsimuni hetsɨa nawi 'uayame hetsɨa.
